protocols.title: Davunetide (5 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. No established injectable dose; all human trials were intranasal, including 30 mg twice daily in the negative phase 2/3 PSP trial. A 5 mg vial + 2 mL bacteriostatic water is reference reconstitution only and not an injectable schedule. Research-only; not FDA-approved.

schedule.description: Intranasal administration, not injection; pivotal PSP trial showed no benefit over placebo.

regimen.notes: All human trials were intranasal. The 30 mg twice-daily, 52-week regimen belongs to a negative PSP trial; there is no validated injectable dose.
